plugins.userTrackingUsageDescription: Your permission lets Livinai use activity from other companies' apps and websites to show more relevant ads and measure advertising performance.

plugins.photosPermission: Livinai needs access to your photos so you can choose a picture of a room, building, or floor plan to redesign. For example, pick a photo of your living room and Livinai generates a restyled version of it.
plugins.cameraPermission: Livinai needs access to your camera so you can photograph a room, building, or floor plan to redesign. For example, take a picture of your bedroom and Livinai generates a restyled version of it.

plugins.photosPermission: Livinai needs access to your photo library so you can choose a picture of a room, building, or floor plan to redesign.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Livinai needs permission to save to your photo library so you can keep the designs it generates. For example, save a redesigned kitchen to Photos to share it with your contractor.

plugins.userTrackingPermission: Your permission lets Livinai use activity from other companies' apps and websites to show more relevant ads and measure advertising performance.
